verdict: GE Vernova grew revenue 16% to $9.3B as orders rose 71% organically to $18.3B, but the headline $4.7B profit was mostly a $4.5B one-time gain from buying the rest of Prolec GE — the underlying business earned far less.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Revenue of $9.3B, up from $8.0B a year ago; +7% organically, led by equipment at Electrification and Power

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP diluted)
kpis.note: Net income was $4.7B, a 50.9% margin — including $4.5B of pre-tax M&A net gains, primarily from Prolec GE

kpis.label: Backlog
kpis.note: Orders of $18.3B in the quarter, +71% organically; backlog grew $13B in three months

kpis.label: Gas Power backlog
kpis.note: Gas equipment backlog plus slot reservations rose from 83 GW to 100 GW — hitting the year-end target in one quarter; the target was raised to at least 110 GW

segments.name: Power
segments.note: Gas turbines and other power-plant equipment and services — the biggest business. Revenue +12% on Gas Power strength; gas equipment backlog plus slot reservations reached 100 GW.

segments.name: Electrification
segments.note: Grid equipment — substations, transformers and high-voltage gear that move electricity. Revenue +61% as reported, including Prolec GE from February 2; +29% organically.

segments.name: Wind
segments.note: Wind turbines, onshore and offshore, plus servicing. Revenue -23% on lower onshore equipment deliveries, and the segment lost $382M at the EBITDA level.

segments.name: Other/eliminations
segments.note: Other revenues minus sales between GE Vernova's own segments, removed so the segments add up to the company total.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Sales teams, offices and running the company.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Developing new turbines, grid and energy-transition technology — about $0.3B funded in the quarter.

takeaways.title: Orders rose 71% organically
takeaways.text: Orders rose 71% organically to $18.3B with growth in all segments, and total backlog grew $13B in one quarter to $163B. Gas Power equipment backlog plus slot reservation agreements leapt from 83 GW to 100 GW, and the company now expects at least 110 GW by year-end 2026.

takeaways.title: A paper gain made the profit
takeaways.text: Net income of $4.7B includes a $3,992M pre-tax gain from remeasuring GE Vernova's old 50% Prolec GE stake when it bought the rest, plus a $330M gain on selling the Proficy software business. Stripping out one-offs, adjusted EBITDA was $896M, up 87%.

takeaways.title: Wind kept shrinking
takeaways.text: Wind revenue fell 23% to $1.4B on lower onshore deliveries and the segment's EBITDA loss widened to $382M, while Electrification revenue jumped 61% to $3.0B with Prolec GE included and Power rose 12% to $5.0B.

oneTimers: Gains on purchases and sales of business interests were $4,405M pre-tax: a $3,992M gain remeasuring the previously held Prolec GE stake, a $330M gain on the sale of the Proficy manufacturing-software business, and an $86M gain on selling an equity-method investment (components per the 10-Q note).
Net interest and investment income of $263M included $251M of gains on the China XD Electric stake ($231M unrealized and $20M realized).

GE Vernova bought the remaining 50% of Prolec GE on February 2, 2026 for about $5.3B of cash, issued $2.6B of senior notes, and incurred $23M of separation costs and $41M of costs under its restructuring plan in the quarter.
Free cash flow was $4.8B in the quarter — more than all of 2025 — and management raised full-year 2026 guidance to $44.5–45.5B of revenue and $6.5–7.5B of free cash flow.
otherDetail: Other income of $4,924M is made up of $28M of interest and other financial income, $134M of non-operating benefit income (pension and retiree-benefit plans), and $4,762M of other income — net. That $4,762M is $4,405M of gains on purchases and sales of business interests, $263M of net interest and investment income (including $251M of China XD Electric gains), $65M of equity-method income, $9M of licensing income, $5M of derivative gains and $14M of other items (components total $4,761M; $1M rounding in the filing).
footerNote: GE Vernova reports in whole $ millions; cost of revenue is the filing's $7,558M combined total and SG&A carries a $1M rounding plug so the lines add up exactly.
